notes.title: Koihime Enbu v1.06 - Network Improvements
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the open beta test we ran was successful, so the latest public update to Koihime Enbu enhances the online experience in line with the beta, addressing spectator issues and room stability.

[h1]Room Stability[/h1]
[list]
[*]An issue where the game would sometimes get stuck after a session error occured
[*]An issue where the game would get stuck following a connection error before starting an online match
[*]An issue where a loss of p2p connection resulting in the room's owner being kicked would result in everyone else being kicked too
[*]Issues where spectators losing their connection was affecting players (now the spectator will be kicked)
[*]Limited the amount of time (10 seconds) the game would wait for spectators to sync up with the match
[*]An issue where one spectator timing out would cause others to time out too
[*]Fixed the amount of time a room would wait for a spectator to sync before kicking them (30 seconds)
[*]And improved connection stability overall
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]An issue where a battle would start before results were updated
[*]Changed behaviour to give a connection error when the game fails to update ranking information at the results screen
[/list]

[h1]Functionality, Changes in Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Player Match room search function to retry after 90 seconds if no room is found.
[*]Changed Ranked Match search function to continue searching if entering the room fails
[*]Changed Quick Match search function to search using the most lenient conditions
[*]Improved search functionality for the Steam version in relation to full rooms
[*]Changed the ranking experience table so higher levels lose less experience when losing a match
[/list]

Hopefully there should be no problems, but please report any issue you find  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/452420/discussions/0/364042063118618355/]here[/url].

[*]Issues where spectators losing their connection was affecting players (now the spectator will be kicked)
[*]Limited the amount of time (10 seconds) the game would wait for spectators to sync up with the match
[*]An issue where one spectator timing out would cause others to time out too
[*]Fixed the amount of time a room would wait for a spectator to sync before kicking them (30 seconds)
[*]And improved connection stability overall
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]An issue where a battle would start before results were updated
[*]Changed behaviour to give a connection error when the game fails to update ranking information at the results screen
[/list]

[h1]Functionality, Changes in Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Player Match room search function to retry after 90 seconds if no room is found.
[*]Changed Ranked Match search function to continue searching if entering the room fails
[*]Changed Quick Match search function to search using the most lenient conditions
[*]Improved search functionality for the Steam version in relation to full rooms
[*]Changed the ranking experience table so higher levels lose less experience when losing match
[/list]

You can try the open beta as follows:
[olist]
[*]In Steam Library, right click on Koihime Enbu in your game list
[*]Open the "Properties" menu and navigate to the "Betas" tab
[*]From the dropdown choose the "open_beta" beta

notes.title: Koihime Enbu & Senko no Ronde 2 at CEOtaku 2017!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Koihime Enbu is one of the 16 official tournament games of [url=http://ceogaming.org/ceotaku]CEOtaku 2017![/url]  
The event starts at 6pm on Friday (22nd) and runs through until Sunday 24th, in Florida.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24352219/058bee1f2935f2026f634167eaf1041b7d6de2ed.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24352219/6d190548d574abf3d0d8b06b72996587a38a4303.png[/img][/url]

To celebrate that we are bringing some very exciting prizes from Tokyo from the developers:
[list][*]Koihime posters!
[*]Soundtracks!
[*]Limited Edition Koihime Enbu for the PlayStation 4 (JP)[/list]
All signed by Koihime Enbu's director and producer, Kouhei Nakamura!

On top of that, we'll be showcasing [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/574160]Senko no Ronde 2[/url] all weekend with an exciting announcement for all you mech/fighting fans.

Senko no Ronde 2 is a fast-paced one-on-one action game mixing elements of fighting games, shooting games and a little action and anime to boot. Released on September 6th for Steam and PlayStation 4, we will have a booth with a FULL playable version of Senko no Ronde 2 at CEOtaku!  If you haven't had the chance to check out this mech-fighter from Japan, come to Orlando and stop by the Degica booth!

We'll also be streaming CEOtaku's Twitch coverage so tune in to Degica Games' Twitch channel to catch all the CEOtaku action and news!

https://www.twitch.tv/degigames

notes.title: Koihime Enbu: v1.05 Network fixes
notes.content:
As the title suggests, we're releasing a new version of Koihime Enbu with many of the network play issues fixed. 
[list]
[*]Desyncing at the character select screen
[*]Spectators causing lag and/or a match to end due to connection errors
[*]Long waits while syncing followed by loss of connection 
[/list]

This, in addition to the previous update which addressed room stability. 
NB: This release is a slightly improved version of the open beta, which is now closed: thanks for your participation.

As always, if you have any problems, please comment [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/452420/discussions/0/364042063118618355/]here[/url] and happy fighting!

notes.title: Koihime Enbu Online: Releasing tournament beta, and a new open beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First, many thanks to Brett and everyone that joined us at Anime Expo! The tournament was very exciting and everyone had a lot of fun!

Also thanks to everyone who participated in the June 25th tournament, that version performed well enough to be the new default for all players, so it has been pushed live today. However, some networking issues remained. We've been hard at work on them and are happy to put out a new beta for you all, that should now have all netcode issues resolved.

Please try it out with your friends and let us know how it performs.

This version is an opt-in beta: to enable it follow the following directions:
[list]
[*]In Steam Library, right click on Koihime Enbu in your game list
[*]Open the "Properties" menu and navigate to the "Betas" tab
[*]From the dropdown choose the "open_beta" beta
[*]Closing the properties menu, Steam should update your game
[*]After update it will show up as "Koihime Enbu [open_beta]"
[/list]
Hopefully there should be no problems, but please report any issue you find in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/452420/discussions/0/2217311444325656617/]open_beta report thread[/url].

Thank you!

notes.title: Koihime Enbu Online Tournament: June 25th! Upcoming Update, New Site!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24352219/57aa63e232f9e1bc8bc430cdd783037659216821.png[/img]

Hi Everyone!

We have a lot happening with Koihime Enbu in the next few weeks! Tournaments, Updates, and more.

So let's take a look at what is coming!

Some of you may have noticed that Koihime Enbu's netcode had a few issues with spectator mode, causing some drops and unexpected room kicks! We have an update coming that we are hoping fixes this.

To test this update, we are bringing back our good friend Brett to host another Koihime Enbu Tournament using the new beta! This tournament will be held on June 25th at 5pm Pacific. Jump in to play, or maybe just watch on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/degigames]Twitch[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24352219/0ad98dbc17750553afd26d9d85bb7b57a7197fd7.png[/img]


To sign up, please head on over to the Koihime Enbu Tournament Challonge sign ups [url=http://challonge.com/KoihimeTournament]here[/url]!

We look forward to seeing you all duke it out on our new netcode! If the update looks stable in the tournament it should roll out not long after that.

And remember, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/452420/announcements/detail/3067363352029052298]with the price drop to just $20 on Steam[/url], jumping into the tournament, even for a newbie is cheaper than ever. Buy today and you have almost a week to practice!

Interested in doing a tournament live? Will you be in LA for Anime Expo? Find us at the Degica Booth on July 1st and 2nd to sign up for our Koihime Enbu Single Elimination Tournament!

The tournament will be held from 4-6pm on Day 2 of the convention (Sun, July 2nd) right at our booth.

And for a final announcement, we are also unveiling our new [url=http://koihimeenbu.degicagames.com/]Koihime Enbu Site[/url]. Here, you can learn about the mechanics, the characters, their movelists, and upcoming Koihime Enbu news! So make sure to check it out!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24352219/357c68d44320445b270aad9c7b35ccad3747b1cf.png[/img]


And that is everything for today Koihime Enbu fans! One online Tournament, one live Tournament, a New Site, and an upcoming Update!

Hope to see you Sunday at the online tournament or in July at Anime Expo!

notes.title: Koihime Enbu: An apology & Error Log Beta release
notes.content:
First an apology on behalf of Degica: Koihime Enbu has been affected by network errors which we have not been able to adequately deal with yet.
It appears they occur under certain circumstances so affect some players more than others. We are working with the developers to correct this, and hopefully today's release will go someway to fix that.

V 1.0.3.5432　Beta release:

This version corrects some bugs, and adds an error reporting feature to allow users to automatically send bug reports relating to online play issues.

Fixes:[list]
[*]Fix to getting stuck on the "Network connection lost" message
[*]Detects when a match is blocked and ends it in online mode
[/list]

[b]Reporting option[/b]:
A number of the online netplay issues some of you are experiencing only seem to happen under very specific conditions. To allow us to gather data in order to fix these issues, an "Error Log" option was added to the configuration menu.
It is OFF by default, but please turn it ON so we can gather as much data about the errors as possible. The data sent only includes details on your machine (specs, network connection etc) and the game's state when the error occurs.

This version is an opt-in beta: to enable it follow the following directions:
[list]
[*]In Steam Library, right click on Koihime Enbu in your game list
[*]Open the "Properties" menu and navigate to the "Betas" tab
[*]From the dropdown choose the "logpublicbeta" beta
[*]Closing the properties menu, Steam should update your game
[*]After update it will show up as "Koihime Enbu [logpublicbeta]"
[/list]

Please try out this beta as much as possible, and enable error log to help us fix those last few problems !

NOTE: Online play is only available between users with the same version, beta users will not be able to netplay with non-beta users.

If you run into any bugs, please report them to the "Bug Reporting - Beta" thread below.

steamcommunity.com/app/452420/discussions/0/350543951939820483

NB the beta version may run slower than usual due to the error logging running in the background.

Thanks for your patience and help

notes.title: Koihime Enbu: v. 1.01 Many fixes including matching
notes.content:
Patch Details:
[list]
[*]Fixed key repeat setting in UI menus
[*]Fixed damage ranking to prevent incorrect characters being registered on leaderboards
[*]Switched update method to use a dedicated archive
[*]Fixed crash when launching from an invite
 To accept invites either 'Accept Invite' or click on 'Join game' in the room owner's profile.
[*]Localisation (Corrected stage name "Wall of The Dawn")
[*]Changed how game determines whether it is online or off
[*]Corrected offline check carried out at the main menu so it works in realtime
[*]Fixed bug where booting game with Steam overlay switched off would cause the game to lock up when displaying a player's profile at the results screen of a ranking match
[/list]
